jobs.title: Chief Legal Officer (CLO) / Legal Counsel - Prytek
jobs.description: London (Hybrid - Remote Flexibility Available) | Full-time The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) / Legal Counsel leads the Group's legal function and acts as a trusted advisor to the Founder, senior management team, and investment team. This role combines strategic deal advisory across M&A, investments and corporate structuring, with responsibility for corporate governance, compliance, risk management and hands-on legal support across a diverse international portfolio of businesses. Key Responsibilities Lead legal execution of M&A and investment transactions: due diligence, structuring, term sheets, SPA/SHA, and closing. Structure holding and investment vehicles (including fund/SPV structures), accounting for cross-jurisdictional and tax considerations. Oversee corporate governance for the Group and portfolio companies: boards, corporate policies, cap tables, and option plans (ESOP). Manage external legal counsel across jurisdictions and control the legal spend budget. Handle commercial contracts: partnerships, suppliers. Own compliance and regulatory matters (including financial licensing, GDPR/data protection, and AML where applicable). Manage risk, disputes, and litigation. Support fundraising and act as the legal point of contact for investors. Requirements Qualified lawyer with a current practising certificate in England & Wales. Extensive post-qualification experience, including a proven track record leading complex M&A transactions and operating as a senior legal adviser to executive leadership teams. Proven track record of cross-border transactions and working within an international structure. Strong deal-structuring and corporate law expertise. Fluent English, Hebrew is a plus. Ability to work at pace and independently manage multiple concurrent transactions. jobs.title: Compliance Lead - CMMC (NIST SP 800-171)
jobs.description: Role Description We are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations. This person is the customer-facing lead for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 engagements and owns NIST SP 800-171 interpretation, scoping, documentation, and assessment readiness from kickoff through the C3PAO assessment and into sustainment. Compliance Lead decides what the systems must satisfy, can configure the controls personally in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 GCC High, writes the record that proves it, and verifies the result the way an assessor would. This is not a coordination role. The Compliance Lead scopes the assessment boundary, authors the System Security Plan and supporting documentation, directs and where needed performs control implementation, assesses the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide, and stands next to the customer during the assessment. They are the day-to-day point of contact for their assigned customers and answer CMMC questions with authority and in plain terms. Customer environments vary: Windows and macOS fleets, GCC High and Google Workspace tenants, Jamf and Intune, cloud and on-prem enclaves. This person has to be versatile enough to work in all of them. Responsibilities The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers for the life of the engagement: run kickoff, working sessions, and status reporting; answer CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 questions directly and accurately without escalation. Scope the CMMC assessment boundary: trace FCI and CUI flows, categorize assets per the CMMC Level 2 Scoping Guide (CUI, Security Protection, Contractor Risk Managed, Specialized, Out of Scope), and produce the boundary, data-flow, and network diagrams. jobs.description: About Abby Care : Powering the future of care at home for all of America. Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve. We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system. Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively. We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future. Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time. The Opportunity: As we expand our capacity to support more family caregivers at scale, we’re growing the teams that support this work. We're looking for a high-agency operator to join us as our Associate General Counsel, Privacy, Product & AI . Reporting to the General Counsel, you'll be the day-to-day owner of Abby Care’s privacy and AI governance programs in a high-tempo, rapidly evolving environment where the regulatory landscape shifts fast and ambiguity is the norm, not the exception. Sitting at the intersection of strategy and execution, this is a senior, build-and-lead role. jobs.title: Commercial Counsel Fellowship
jobs.description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. *Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers. About the role Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco. Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way. No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
